Build the image first (`docker build -t fastapi-dojo:1.0.0 .`) and check it starts locally: `docker run --rm -p 8000:8000 fastapi-dojo:1.0.0`. If it crashes on startup with PermissionError, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 is missing from the Dockerfile ENV.

For the Dockerfile non-root fix: `RUN addgroup --system app && adduser --system --ingroup app app` then `USER app` before CMD. For deployment.yaml: set `imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent` (not Always) or the kubelet will try to pull from a registry that doesn't have the image.

The readOnlyRootFilesystem container will crash without a writable /tmp. Add a volume: `{name: tmp, emptyDir: {medium: Memory}}` and a volumeMount: `{name: tmp, mountPath: /tmp}`. Check pod events with `kubectl describe pod -n dojo-fastapi` for the exact error.
